title: 第5章 变强！！变强！！
content_zh:
第一卷初临异世 第五章 变强！！变强！！

在柜台边的哈克老爹忙跑过来，拉起刘枫，对着红衣美女歉声道：“对不起，对不起，他这孩子从来就这样，还请大人不要责怪。”

红衣美女撇过头去，不再看向刘枫，对哈克老爹轻声说道：“老伯，我是星蓝学院的学生尼古拉.雪，是这次来接薇儿小姐去学院的。”

“哦，原来如此，真是要麻烦你了。”哈克老爹恍然，转过头对刘枫叫道：“啊枫，快去上楼叫薇儿。”

刘枫点了点头，深深的看了一眼尼古拉.雪，转身向楼上跑去，心中默念：“尼古拉.雪，真是要谢谢你，是你让我彻底明白了这个世界的规则，谁的拳头大，谁就是天，所以，记住我这个黑头发的人，将来会找你加倍要回我今天所受到的侮辱。”

见刘枫上了楼去，哈克老爹松了口气，对尼古拉.雪道：“尼古拉小姐，你请在这里坐一下，薇儿马上就下来。”

尼古拉.雪轻轻点了点头，随便找了张桌子坐下，她身边的那些冒险者，“轰”的全散了，他们可不想无故的挨顿臭打。

尼古拉.雪并没有等多久，很快的刘枫便带着眼睛红红的薇儿下了楼来。

刘枫低声对薇儿说道：“去跟爷爷道个别吧，然后跟着那位红衣姐姐去学院吧。”

哈克老爹在旁边笑道：“有什么好道别的，还是快跟尼古拉小姐去学院吧。”

“你就没有什么话跟我说了吗？”薇儿美丽大眼睛，充满期待的看着刘枫。

看着薇儿那期待的眼光，刘枫心中一片柔软，拉着她的小手，柔声道：“今生，我会翻遍十万大山，不为修来世，只为路中能与你相见。”（抄袭，嘻嘻）

薇儿美丽的大眼之中，晶莹正在生长，使劲抽了抽雪白娇挺的鼻子，强忍着不使之落下。

旁边，尼古拉。雪凭借敏锐的耳力，听到了刘枫的柔声，冰冷的心不由轻轻一颤，美丽的大眼斜瞟了刘枫一眼,似乎有些不敢相信如此美妙的诗句会从一个魔武废人口中道出.

“尼古拉小姐，我们走吧。”薇儿轻声道。

“薇儿妹妹，以后叫我学姐就好。”尼古拉.雪对薇儿到是很和善，抿嘴笑道。

“走吧，外面有狮鹫，很快就到学院了。”尼古拉.雪点了点头道。

屋外，一只似狮似鸟的巨兽盘卧在地，这便是这个世界上最为快捷的运输魔兽，类似与地球上的飞机，当然，它的速度肯定及不上飞机。

看着盘旋而起的狮鹫，刘枫在心中默道：薇儿，等着我，等我再次出现在祢眼前的时候，将是另一种身份，还有，尼古拉.雪，希望你也给我等着。”

距薇儿走了的时候已经有三天了，刘枫在这三天内功也有了极大的长进，现在只要一入定，天地间的元气就源源不断的朝身体里涌来，“疾风步”的使用时间也从10秒延长到了15秒。

他昨天找到了一处天地元气极为充盈的所在，由于知道自己这次修炼的时间可能会有点长，所以准备好了东西，并给哈克老爹打了招呼。

提着一把铁剑，大步的踏入了冒险者的天堂“死亡森林”。

因为是在森林外围，一路上并没有遇见什么厉害的魔兽，只有一些一级的小魔兽，凭刘枫现在的身手，对付它们也算是小菜一叠，顺手解决完后，又继续埋头赶路。

一个小时之后，刘枫喘了口气，自语道：“终于要到了”，现在这里也算是在“死亡森林”的中部了，因为这里经常出没五阶以上的魔兽，所以来的冒险者一般比较少。

前方不远处，传来了，“轰，轰”的水流撞击声，刘枫知道，自己的目的地到了。

这是一条瀑布，长长的水链如水银般的倾泻而下，重重的撞击在岩石之上，发出“轰轰”的震天响声，让人禁不住为大自然的威力而折服！！

深吸一口气，充盈的元气顺着喉咙进入体内，使精神为之一震。

刘枫极为满意的点了点头，赞道：“果然是块宝地，在地球上修炼上一天还抵不上在这里深吸一口气哩。”

来到昨天找好的地方，这是一个离地有三米多高的洞穴，不知是谁人所造，既隐蔽又可以防魔兽，而且离瀑布近，元气充足，正是修炼的好地方。

刘枫现在变强的决心空前的强烈，在这片强者为尊的大陆上，没有实力的人只有遭到鄙视与不屑。

刘枫不想再次遭受到尼古拉.雪那样的侮辱，而且他可不想日后要薇儿来保护自己，哪个男人没有点大男人气节，薇儿现在去了星蓝学院，日后她只会越来越强，为了不与薇儿的距离越来越大，所以，刘枫必须也得变强。

在地球，他因为平凡，而没有野心，但是，如今，他到了这个强者的世界，而且，他也有了成为强者的资本，所以，刘枫并不甘心做一个平凡的人。

虽然不至于去做那什么争霸大陆的事，可最基本的却是保护自己的女人，不使之受到一丁点的伤害。

体内那丝真气已经有手指般粗大，原本紧缩的经脉也被这丝真气阔宽了许多，变得更加的圆润与坚韧。

天地间的元气源源不断的涌入刘枫体内，不断的被提纯，然后被吸入丹田，加入到那丝真气中，使之不断壮大。

修炼之时没有任何的时间概念，转眼就是一上午，刘枫现在并没有到达那传说中“辟谷”,所以他也得吃饭。

坐起身来，伸了一个懒腰，浑身骨头“霹雳扒拉”的象鞭炮一般响个不停。

刘枫嘴角勾起一个懒懒的笑容，低声道：“就是这种感觉。。。不断变强的感觉。”

“我似乎已经喜欢上了这种感觉了哩。”

拳脚舞动，带起一股股劲风，在这小小的山洞中来回的飞舞着。

“不知道，我现在的实力算得上几阶？应该有四阶吧？”刘枫收了拳脚，自语道。

其实刘枫还是算高估自己了，他现在最多也就算是一个二阶剑士，毕竟他不是什么天纵奇才，就算是凭借华夏内功，也不可能在短短几天之内，达到四阶。

不过，若是刘枫启动“疾风步”的话，莫说是三阶，就要对付一个五阶武者，也并不是不可能，以有心算无心之下，加上“疾风步”第一次攻击翻倍的特效，有很大的机率能够成功。

现在，刘枫体内的真气极少，所以除了身体比以前强壮了些和“疾风步”的使用时间稍稍长了点之外，其实也并没有其他特别的地方，只有当体内的真气达到了一个量时，并且在丹田之中形成了一个气旋之后，刘枫才算是真正的踏入了内功的殿门，到时，便可以利用气旋里的真气进行一个重要的坏节。

如果成功了的话，到时候实力才会开始飞奔猛涨，现在的刘枫还是只有慢慢的积累，静待春蛹化蝶的那天。
content_en:
Volume 1: First Coming to Another World Chapter 5: Becoming Stronger!!Become stronger!!

Father Huck who was at the counter hurriedly ran over, pulled up Liu Feng, and apologized to the beauty in red: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, this kid has always been like this, please don't blame me."

The beauty in red turned her head, no longer looking at Liu Feng, and said softly to Daddy Huck: "Uncle, I am Nicholas Snow, a student of Xinglan Academy. I am here to pick up Miss Wei'er to go to the academy."

"Oh, I see, I really want to trouble you." Daddy Huck suddenly realized, turned to Liu Feng and shouted: "Ah Feng, go upstairs and call Wei'er."

Liu Feng nodded, took a deep look at Nicola Snow, turned around and ran upstairs, thinking silently in his heart: "Nicola Snow, I really want to thank you. It is you who made me completely understand the rules of this world. Whoever has a big fist is the king. So, remember that I, a black-haired person, will come to you in the future to double the insult I suffered today."

Seeing Liu Feng going upstairs, Father Huck breathed a sigh of relief and said to Nicola Snow: "Miss Nicola, please sit here for a moment. Weier will come down soon."

Nicola Snow nodded slightly and found a table to sit down. The adventurers around her all dispersed with a "boom". They didn't want to be beaten for no reason.

Nicola Snow did not wait long, and soon Liu Feng came downstairs with Weier, who had red eyes.

Liu Feng whispered to Weier: "Go say goodbye to grandpa, and then follow the sister in red to the academy."

Daddy Huck smiled beside him and said, "If you have anything to say goodbye, let's go to the academy with Miss Nicholas."

"Don't you have anything to say to me?" Weier's beautiful big eyes looked at Liu Feng expectantly.

Looking at Wei'er's expectant eyes, Liu Feng felt soft in his heart. He took her little hand and said softly: "In this life, I will climb hundreds of thousands of mountains, not to cultivate the afterlife, just to meet you on the road." (Plagiarism, hehe)

In Weier's beautiful big eyes, the sparkle was growing. She twitched her snow-white nose hard, trying not to let it fall.

Beside, Nikolai.With her keen ears, Xue heard Liu Feng's soft voice. Her cold heart couldn't help but tremble slightly. She glanced sideways at Liu Feng with her beautiful big eyes, as if she couldn't believe that such a beautiful poem could come from the mouth of a useless magic weapon.

"Miss Nicholas, let's go." Weier said softly.

"Sister Weier, just call me Senior Sister from now on." Nicholas Snow was very kind to Weier, and said with a pursed smile.

"Let's go, there are griffins outside, we will be at the academy soon." Nicholas Snow nodded.

Outside the house, a giant beast that looks like a lion and a bird lies on the ground. This is the fastest transport monster in the world, similar to an airplane on earth. Of course, its speed is definitely not as fast as an airplane.

Looking at the hovering griffon, Liu Feng said silently in his heart: Wei'er, wait for me. When I appear in front of you again, it will be another identity. Also, Nicola Snow, I hope you will wait for me too."

It has been three days since Wei'er left, and Liu Feng's internal skills have also improved greatly in these three days. Now, as soon as he enters concentration, the energy from heaven and earth flows into his body continuously, and the use time of "Wind Step" has also been extended from 10 seconds to 15 seconds.

Yesterday, he found a place where the vitality of heaven and earth was extremely abundant. Since he knew that his practice time might be a bit long, he prepared his things and said hello to Father Huck.

Holding an iron sword, he strode into the adventurer's paradise "Forest of Death".

Because we were outside the forest, we didn't encounter any powerful monsters along the way, only some first-level small monsters. With Liu Feng's current skills, dealing with them was a piece of cake. After handling them easily, he continued on his way.

An hour later, Liu Feng took a breath and said to himself: "We are finally here." This place is now considered to be in the middle of the "Forest of Death". Because monsters above level five are often found here, there are generally fewer adventurers here.

Not far ahead, there was a "boom, boom" sound of water hitting, and Liu Feng knew that his destination had arrived.

This is a waterfall. A long chain of water pours down like mercury, hitting the rocks heavily, making a loud "booming" sound. People can't help but be impressed by the power of nature!!

Taking a deep breath, the abundant vitality entered the body along the throat, shocking the spirit.

Liu Feng nodded with great satisfaction and praised: "It is indeed a treasured land. One day of cultivation on earth is not worth taking a deep breath here."

We arrived at the place we found yesterday. It was a cave more than three meters high above the ground. I don’t know who made it. It was both hidden and protected from monsters. It was also close to the waterfall and had plenty of energy. It was a good place for training.

Liu Feng's determination to become stronger now is unprecedentedly strong. In this continent where the strong are respected, those without strength will only be despised and disdained.

Liu Feng didn't want to suffer the same insult as Nicola Snow again, and he didn't want Weier to protect him in the future. What man didn't have some masculinity? Weier went to Xinglan Academy now, and she would only get stronger in the future. In order not to get farther and farther away from Weier, Liu Feng must also become stronger.

On Earth, he had no ambition because he was ordinary. However, now that he has arrived in this world of strong people, and he also has the capital to become a strong person, Liu Feng is not willing to be an ordinary person.

Although he wouldn't do anything to fight for the continent's hegemony, the most basic thing is to protect his woman from any harm.

The strand of true energy in the body is already as thick as a finger, and the originally tight meridians have been broadened by this strand of true energy, becoming more rounded and tough.

The vitality between heaven and earth poured into Liu Feng's body continuously, was continuously purified, and then was sucked into the dantian, adding to the true energy, making it continue to grow.

There is no concept of time when practicing. One morning has passed in the blink of an eye. Liu Feng has not reached the legendary "bigu" yet, so he also has to eat.

He sat up and stretched, and the bones all over his body were crackling like firecrackers.

Liu Feng raised a lazy smile on his lips and whispered: "That's how it feels...The feeling of getting stronger."

"I seem to have fallen in love with this feeling."

The fists and feet danced, bringing up strong winds that flew back and forth in the small cave.

"I don't know, what level of strength am I at now?There should be level four, right?"Liu Feng withdrew his fists and feet and said to himself.

In fact, Liu Feng still overestimates himself. He can only be regarded as a second-level swordsman at most now. After all, he is not a genius. Even with the help of Chinese internal strength, he cannot reach the fourth level in just a few days.

However, if Liu Feng activates "Wind Step", it is not impossible to deal with a fifth-level warrior, not to mention a third-level warrior. With mental arithmetic and unintentional calculations, plus the special effect of doubling the first attack of "Wind Step", there is a high chance that he can succeed.

Now, there is very little zhenqi in Liu Feng's body, so apart from the fact that his body is stronger than before and the "Wind Step" has been used for a little longer, there is actually nothing special about him. Only when the zhenqi in his body reaches a certain amount and a cyclone is formed in his dantian, can Liu Feng truly step into the palace of internal strength. At that time, he can use the zhenqi in the cyclone to perform an important attack.

If he succeeds, then his strength will start to soar. Now Liu Feng can only accumulate slowly and wait for the day when the chrysalis turns into a butterfly.
